points.title: Your personal data is used to employ targeted third-party advertising

points.case_title: This service claims that your personal data is not being sold
points.quote_text: We are not in the business of selling or renting your personal data.
points.title: Your personal data is not sold

points.case_title: The service claims that third parties it shares your personal information with are bound by confidentiality obligations
points.quote_text: <li>We disclose your personal data with our service providers who process data on our behalf, such as credit card processors and customer management systems. We require these providers to agree to strict data protection requirements in keeping with our privacy policy standards and our obligations under applicable privacy laws.
points.title: Third parties used by the service are bound by confidentiality obligations

points.case_title: You are warned of the potential consequences related to third-party access
points.quote_text: You can use a variety of third-party services and applications that interact with the Evernote Service, and you should review the access rights you provide to those services or applications, as you may enable them to access or extract your Content through your agreements with those parties.
points.title: You are warned of the potential consequences related to third-party access

points.case_title: The data retention period is kept to the minimum necessary for fulfilling its purposes
points.quote_text: Our retention of your personal data is based upon several factors, including the length of time necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, to make the Evernote Service available to you, to demonstrate that we have fulfilled our business and legal duties and obligations and contractual commitments, or as instructed by you, unless a longer period is required or permitted by law.
points.title: The data retention period is kept to the minimum necessary for fulfilling its purposes

points.case_title: You shall not interfere with another person's enjoyment of the service
points.quote_text: You Won’t Annoy or Scam Our Users.
points.title: You shall not interfere with another person's enjoyment of the service

points.case_title: You are informed about the risk of publishing personal info online
points.quote_text: You determine whether to post personal or otherwise sensitive information to publicly accessible areas of the Evernote site, so you should carefully consider how you use the Service. We are not responsible for any publication or use of any information you choose to post in these locations.
points.title: You are informed about the risk of publishing personal info online

points.case_title: The service will only respond to government requests that are reasonable
points.quote_text: We will not disclose your personal data to law enforcement or other governmental authorities unless we believe it is required to comply with warrants, court orders, subpoenas, or other lawful government requests.
points.title: The service will only respond to government requests that are reasonable

points.case_title: The service will try to inform and/or notify you regarding government inquiries that may involve your personal information
points.quote_text: In accordance with our Information for Law Enforcement Authorities page, we will notify you if we believe we are compelled to comply with a third party’s legal demand for your information, and we routinely push back on government orders to delay user notice that we view as overly broad.
points.title: The service will try to inform and/or notify you regarding government inquiries that may involve your personal information

points.case_title: The service will resist legal requests for your information where reasonably possible
points.quote_text: In accordance with our Information for Law Enforcement Authorities page, we will notify you if we believe we are compelled to comply with a third party’s legal demand for your information, and we routinely push back on government orders to delay user notice that we view as overly broad.
points.title: The service will resist legal requests for your information where reasonably possible

points.case_title: You can request access, correction and/or deletion of your data
points.quote_text: If you prefer, you can contact us using our web form to ask us to provide access to, correct, update, or delete your personal data.
points.title: You can request access, correction and/or deletion of your data

points.case_title: Some personal data may be kept for business interests or legal obligations
points.quote_text: Specific legal obligations might require different retention periods and, in such cases, those different periods will apply.
points.title: Some personal data may be kept for business interests or legal obligations

points.case_title: Your personal data may be used for marketing purposes
points.quote_text: Market, promote, and maximize your engagement with the Services. In accordance with your communication preferences, we may use your personal data to send you promotional communications that may be of specific interest to you, such as information about new products and features, tips for using the Evernote Service, special offers, and information about how Evernote works with products and services from our business partners.
points.title: Your personal data may be used for marketing purposes

points.case_title: Do Not Track (DNT) headers are ignored and you are tracked anyway even if you set this header
points.quote_text: At this time, we do not currently respond to or otherwise take action in response to web browser "do not track" signals.
points.title: Do Not Track (DNT) headers are ignored and you are tracked anyway even if you set this header

points.case_title: You agree not to use the service for illegal purposes
points.quote_text: You Won’t Use Evernote for Anything Illegal or Promote Illegal Activities.
points.title: You agree not to use the service for illegal purposes

points.case_title: Spidering, crawling, or accessing the site through any automated means is not allowed
points.quote_text: Unless Evernote has given you its prior approval, don’t access or attempt to access the Evernote Service by any means other than through the interface provided by Evernote (including through the use of scripts, web crawlers or the like).
points.title: Spidering, crawling, or accessing the site through any automated means is not allowed

points.case_title: You are prohibited from sending chain letters, junk mail, spam or any unsolicited messages
points.quote_text: Don’t upload, post or otherwise transmit any unsolicited or unauthorized advertising or promotional materials. So no spam, no pyramid schemes, and definitely no “I got kidnapped and need you to wire me $1,000” schemes.
points.title: You are prohibited from sending chain letters, junk mail, spam or any unsolicited messages

points.case_title: You are prohibited from publishing any third party’s personally identifiable information without their consent
points.quote_text: Don’t invade another’s privacy, and don’t use someone’s personal data for commercial purposes or in some other manner that violates their rights or applicable laws. This also means you shouldn’t upload, post or otherwise transmit any Content that you don’t have a right to transmit under any law or under contractual or fiduciary relationships (e.g., inside information, confidential information learned or disclosed as part of employment relationships or under nondisclosure agreements).
points.title: The publishing of personally identifiable information without the owner’s consent is not allowed

points.case_title: The posting of pornographic content is prohibited
points.quote_text: You Won’t Use Shared or Public Notebooks to Post Objectionable Content. Don’t upload, publish or display Content that contains nudity, sexually graphic material or material that is otherwise deemed explicit by Evernote;
points.title: The posting of pornographic content is prohibited

points.case_title: You agree not to submit libelous, harassing or threatening content
points.quote_text: You Won’t Use Shared or Public Notebooks to Post Objectionable Content. Don’t upload, publish or display Content that contains nudity, sexually graphic material or material that is otherwise deemed explicit by Evernote; that Evernote deems threatening, abusive, harassing, defamatory, libelous, obscene, invasive, hateful or racially, ethnically or otherwise objectionable; or that Evernote determines conflicts with your obligations under applicable local law or these User Guidelines.
points.title: You agree not to submit libelous, harassing or threatening content

points.case_title: The service claims to be CCPA compliant for California users
points.quote_text: Consumers residing in California are afforded certain additional rights with respect to their personal information under the California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended from time to time, including the California Privacy Rights Act and its implementation regulations (“CCPA”) (California Civil Code Section 1798.100 et seq.).
points.title: The service claims to be CCPA compliant for California users
